what: Stage 1 vertical-stack budgets for biomes/arcflow (Kulaneva, rmwetn7jqgm9g): 5 station HTML pages (< 2.0 MB each via arcflow.tex.js sidecar), max samplers <= 15, and estimated VRAM <= 380 MB.

arcflow.html.why: Station 1 (klint): 55 m Kulaneva-Klint horseshoe waterfall over kukersite oil-shale & glauconitic blue amber-clay with sidecar textures.

arcflow-koski.html.why: Station 2 (koski): Helme-Koski zebra-cumulate 3-step rapids, Hiidenkirnu amber swirl-kettles & Carnelian skerry ribs with sidecar textures.

arcflow-seep.html.why: Station 3 (seep): pH 11.5 Ca-OH cerulean travertine cascades, Jumala-Tuli H2/CH4 cold-flames & 60% Carnelian spire-garden with sidecar textures.

arcflow-neva.html.why: Station 4 (neva): Musta-Jogi tea-black humic fen, raha-maak penny-ore shoals & crimson kalju-selka serpentinite islands with sidecar textures.

arcflow-auger.html.why: Station 5 (auger): NE serpentinite Carnelian red-barren, bone-white Bleach-Swath & 45 m ecof_soil_auger lime-oasis with sidecar textures.

*.why: Shared arcflow.tex.js texture sidecar pack serving all five Arcflow station pages.
